svg.text: 121GW LCD: digits, bargraph and annunciators with the names used in this project
Every segment lit (the boot RANGE all-segments test). Layout schematic, not to scale. Code = (COM << 6) | SEG; C = COM 0-3, S = SEG 0-43.
bargraph: 25 segments (g_bar_count 0-25) + bar0 tick; range labels 0xC7 C3 S7, 0x4B C1 S11 (Bar_RangeLabel)
Digit segments (COM, SEG) per position: segment letters as on digit pos 5 above
LCD: the STM32L152's own controller, 4 COM x 44 SEG, 1/4 duty, 1/3 bias, LSI clock; drawn into an 8-word RAM shadow that LCD_Flush copies.
Digit position 0 = left of the sub display, 5 = left of the main display. dpN = decimal point with N digits after it. HV (0x27) is the high-voltage icon, lit from 30 V.
